text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Run in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe now, 
or wait another year? To her indecision, 
her former homeroom teacher says: 'You 
must choose the path that makes your heart 
sting.'

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The conclusion Nakayama Festa reached was—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To have her former homeroom teacher live 
another year and see her win the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe. ...A gamble with 
near-zero odds.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still, there could be no match more 
thrilling than this! In pursuit of the 
strength needed to win, she pressed on, 
once again asking El Condor Pasa for her 
assistance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen. Nakayama Festa takes 
on the "Generalissimo of Japan." If she 
aims for the world, this is one of the 
first walls she must overcome.
